# Target Project Structure (generated by /astra-methodology)

When the plugin initializes a target project (via `/project-init`, `/sprint-init`, `/service-planner`, `/manual-generator`, `/catalog-generator`), it creates the following structure:

```
{project}/
├── CLAUDE.md                          # Project-specific AI rules
├── docs/
│   ├── design-system/                 # SSoT design system (v5.2.0+)
│   │   ├── DESIGN.md                  # SSoT — YAML Front Matter (tokens) + Markdown Body (philosophy/components/a11y). Generated by /design-init.
│   │   ├── components.md              # Legacy detail reference
│   │   ├── layout-grid.md             # Layout/breakpoint guide
│   │   ├── preview.html               # /design-init token preview
│   │   ├── audit-{date}.md            # /design-redesign reports
│   │   └── extract-report-{date}.md   # /design-extract reports
│   ├── blueprints/                    # Feature design documents
│   │   ├── overview.md                # Project overview
│   │   ├── {NNN}-{feature-name}/      # Numbered feature directories (e.g., 001-auth/)
│   │   │   └── blueprint.md           # Main design document + related files
│   ├── planner/                       # Planning deliverables (Design Thinking) + design-system HTML mockups
│   │   └── {NNN}-{feature-name}/      # Numbered feature directories (e.g., 001-auth/)
│   │       ├── market-analysis.md     # Market/competitor analysis (PEST, SWOT, benchmarking)
│   │       ├── interview-report.md    # Persona interview results
│   │       ├── requirements-definition.md # Requirements (KPI/OKR, JTBD, traceability)
│   │       ├── usecase-definition.md  # Use cases with customer journey maps
│   │       ├── ia-screen-design.md    # IA structure, screen flow, wireframes + HTML preview index
│   │       ├── feature-definition.md  # Features with story map, risk, policies
│   │       ├── index.html             # HTML mockup navigation hub
│   │       ├── styles.css             # Shared styles (design tokens + components + animations)
│   │       └── SCR-001.html ~ SCR-NNN.html # Per-screen static HTML mockups (responsive + dark mode)
│   ├── database/                      # DB design (SSoT), naming rules, migrations
│   ├── tests/                         # Test strategy, test cases (per sprint), test reports
│   ├── sprints/                       # Sprint documents (prompt maps, progress trackers, retrospectives)
│   ├── delivery/                     # Release artifacts
│   └── manual/                       # Service manuals (generated by /manual-generator)
│       └── {feature-name}/           # Per-feature manual
│           ├── index.html            # Cover + TOC + search
│           ├── chapters/             # Chapter HTML files (01-getting-started.html, etc.)
│           ├── assets/               # CSS (tokens, base, components, print)
│           ├── screenshots/          # Captured screenshots (desktop/, tablet/, mobile/)
│           └── shared/               # Common JS (nav, search, theme)
├── catalog/                           # Product catalogs (generated by /catalog-generator)
│   └── {catalog-name}/               # Per-catalog package
│       ├── index.html                 # Catalog main page
│       ├── assets/                    # CSS, JS, fonts
│       └── images/                    # Product & lifestyle images (fect-image)
└── src/
    └── styles/
        └── design-tokens.css         # AUTO-GENERATED from docs/design-system/DESIGN.md — regenerate via /design-init --regenerate-css. 3-tier tokens (OKLCH, Geist+Pretendard, fluid typography, spring animations).
```

## Naming Conventions

- **Blueprint directory**: `docs/blueprints/{NNN}-{feature-name}/blueprint.md` — 3-digit zero-padded sequential numbers
- **Planner directory**: `docs/planner/{NNN}-{feature-name}/` — same numbering as blueprint
- **Sprint directory**: `docs/sprints/sprint-{N}-{feature-name}/` — includes primary blueprint name for traceability
- **Handoff directory**: Branch root `{feature-name}-handoff/` (intentional — designers/QA clone without navigating into engineering code)

## Per-Skill Output Locations

Refer to each skill's SKILL.md for detailed output specifications:
- `/service-planner` → `docs/planner/{NNN}-{feature-name}/` (6 markdown deliverables + HTML set)
- `/handoff-publish` → `{feature-name}-handoff/` (14 files including SSoT registry)
- `/manual-generator` → `docs/manual/{feature-name}/` (self-contained HTML)
- `/catalog-generator` → `catalog/{catalog-name}/` (self-contained HTML)
- `/sprint-init` → `docs/sprints/sprint-{N}-{feature-name}/`
- `/design-init` → `docs/design-system/DESIGN.md` + `src/styles/design-tokens.css` (generated) + `docs/design-system/preview.html`
- `/design-extract` → `docs/design-system/extract-report-{date}.md` (then optionally merges into DESIGN.md)
- `/design-redesign` → `docs/design-system/audit-{date}.md` + in-place code patches
- `/design-audit` → terminal output only (no file output)
